Hi Jamie —

Marcus here from Redwood Inference. Vanessa suggested I reach out — thanks for being open to helping other teams, we really appreciate it.

Context: AegisPay (prospect) is in late-stage talks with Redwood. They are specifically evaluating our claims automation and policy migration approach for a multi-tenant migration off their legacy on-prem stack. The commercial team asked for a 20–30 minute peer call with a customer who migrated and can speak to performance, operational overhead, and any pitfalls.

Draft agenda (30 minutes):
- Intros (5m)
- Migration approach & timeline (8m)
- Performance metrics & day-2 ops (8m)
- Q&A and follow-ups (9m)

If you're able to help we would:
1) Ask you to join a 30-min call with AegisPay's engineering/ops (no sales pitch, focused on technical experience).
2) Share a one-page case summary ahead of the call.
3) Respect any PR/quote constraints — we'll get a signed consent if required.

Available windows next week (all EDT): Tue 8/2 16:00–17:00, Wed 8/3 10:00–12:00, Thu 8/4 14:00–16:00. Let me know any that work or suggest alternatives.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan-AGP-2027-092.pdf (placeholder MAM with proposed agenda/contacts)

Thanks again — if helpful I can loop in AegisPay's CTO to align on scope once we have a time.

Best,
Marcus

Hey Marcus —

Happy to help. Quick answers up front: Tue 8/2 16:00 EDT works for me. I can speak to migration timeline, what we had to rework in our pipelines, and some of the cost/latency wins.

A few notes:
- We typically avoid live production metrics in calls without PR clearance; if you'll want specific numbers we need a short PR consent form signed (I can send ours).
- We prefer a short pre-call list of questions so I can pull the right logs and charts — otherwise it's hard to reference exact numbers.
- If AegisPay wants to include procurement/contracting people that's fine, but I prefer technical panel (CTO/Eng manager).

I also attached our small PR approval checklist for reference.

Cheers,
Jamie Torres
Head of Platform | ShieldSure
jamie@shield-sure.com
